title: Jamaican Mussels Bake
description: A flavorful and spicy seafood dish featuring mussels in a Jamaican-inspired broth, baked in the oven with vibrant and flaky toppings.
instructions: Rinse the mussels and remove any broken shells.
In a large bowl, combine the mussels, jerk seasoning, bell peppers, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the coconut milk into the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with breadcrumbs.
Drizzle the olive oil over the breadcrumbs.
Cut the lime in half and place on top of the breadcrumbs.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the mussels are cooked and the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
